the_proposed_axis.score9_gate_proposal: engine catch-rate >= 0.60 on seeded items (an absolute floor: the majority of real defects caught) AND the engine-minus-bare CI excludes 0 above bare (the relative value over the cheapest arm, the Art. 20 discipline) AND false-alarm <= 0.25 (the feasibility number already gated) — all three must hold

the_proposed_axis.the_auditor_enacts: this is a PROPOSAL: the auditor may enact it verbatim, re-number the gates, or name a different measurable axis (e.g. a fresh discrimination task with headroom); NOTHING in this file changes the score gates until the auditor's adjudication adopts it
